room.name: Ball of Swine spiral maze and stairwell
room.description: Rounded tunnels spiral around a courtyard, with portcullises and three bridge approaches. The final boss encounter reveals the arena and its stairwell. The switch chamber and Speedbump construction area are subregions/states, not separate destinations.

room.name: Goblin workshop and adjoining boss chamber
room.description: A goblin engineering and explosives workshop connected to the War Chieftain’s chamber. Workshop equipment is an adaptation of its stated use; exact machinery and room plan are not canonical.
